art_direction: Painted diffuse, original 2001 early-PS2 psychological horror technique. No modern pore/normal/roughness/subsurface maps. All maps 512px.

Head_Diffuse.png.description: Warm-neutral #B79A87 with painted socket, nasal-side/nostril-wing, cheek, lip-surround and jaw shading. No painted eyeballs or mouth cavity.

Zombie_Head_Diffuse.png.description: Optional subdued sallow skin; clean master diffuse remains intact.

BruiseDecalRGBA.png.description: Soft asymmetric bruise; optional alpha-over layer.

DirtDecalRGBA.png.description: Restrained cheek/jaw dirt; optional alpha-over layer.

BloodDecalRGBA.png.description: Painted dried blood at one mouth corner; optional alpha-over layer.

Jacket_Diffuse.png.description: Painted cloth: broad quiet variation, curved fold shading, subdued narrow panel lines. No random noise, checker patches or photographic weave.

Trousers_Diffuse.png.description: Painted cloth: broad quiet variation, curved fold shading, subdued narrow panel lines. No random noise, checker patches or photographic weave.

Fleece_Diffuse.png.description: Painted cream fleece with fine crescent curls 3-6 pixels across; no shaded popcorn lumps.

Hair_Diffuse.png.description: Dark brown-black with grouped curved directional streaks and quiet warm/cool variation; no simulated individual hairs.

Boots_Diffuse.png.description: Subdued brown leather with a few painted flex folds; no PBR grain or baked laces.

uv_contracts.head_front: u=.5+x/.20, v=(z-1.53)/.28; meters. PNG top row is high v. Eyes x=+/- .034,z=1.684; mouth z=1.6145. Same contract on zombie and decals.
uv_contracts.tile: Repeating projection at 2.5 per meter, one tile spans .4m. Fold/panel painting is generic; do not treat as a packed garment atlas.
uv_contracts.hair_clump: Align UV v with clump root-to-tip; curved streaks run along v.

material_notes: Feed sRGB diffuse to simple material base color. Matte values may be constant (skin .75, cloth .9, hair .82, boots .8); no subsurface required. Alpha-over optional decals only; clean maps contain no injury/dirt.
resolution_reason: 512 is enough for these broad painted features; no expression benefit from duplicated 1024 maps.
limits: Painted shadows support form and can be visible under opposing strong illumination.
Frontal UV projection needs a separate uniform skin material/UV region for exposed rear head/neck.
Generic tile fold/seam placement is not tailored to individual UV garment islands.
Texture validation does not establish rendered character quality; Blender integration needs visual QA.
